punch.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production-ready transparent sprite atlas for a hand-painted dark fantasy 2D side-scrolling action game, "lightning gauntlet basic punch" visual effect only.
Primary request: exactly EIGHT distinct consecutive animation frames, laid out as a strict 4 columns by 2 rows sprite sheet on a fully transparent alpha background. Canvas landscape 1536 by 1024 if possible. Each equal cell is 384 by 512. Leave wide clear transparent gutters between all eight effects. No visible grid.
Art direction: intricate painterly white-hot platinum and warm golden lightning with a few thin pale blue electric filaments. Powerful punch shock and sharp asymmetric forked electric branches, like gilded fantasy combat illustration. Crisp expressive silhouette at game size, controlled luminous detail rather than a huge glowing blob. Short-range melee punch impact, never a long laser, never a projectile.
Geometry: every frame is oriented left to right with the same emitter anchor at cell-local x approximately 76 pixels, y 256 pixels. Keep every effect within its own cell, approximately x 45..350 and y 165..345, with no effect crossing a cell edge. The design is horizontally compressed into a short thrust cone or compact punch shock, with a dense narrow source, then fractured forked gold-white lightning toward the right. Do not draw an actual fist, arm, weapon or character. The attacker will be added by the game at the emitter anchor.
Frame sequence in reading order:
1 upper-left: tiny tightly coiled charge wisps around the emitter, a restrained gathering crescent facing right.
2: charge intensifies into a compact angular electric knot near emitter, a small forward tongue begins.
3: forceful short lightning thrust extends right, white core with golden fork branches, sharp forward motion.
4: peak punch shock at the right-hand end, bright concentrated split impact core, jagged flaring branches along short thrust, plenty of transparent negative space.
5 lower-left: fractured impact burst spreading mostly forward/up/down at the right-hand end, source remains small, asymmetric golden filaments.
6: residual curved arcs and separated electric splinters, diminished white core.
7: thinner scattered fading gold arcs, no dense core.
8 lower-right: only a few final tiny electrical motes near the impact end and residual fine filaments.
Composition: same scale and emitter alignment across all frames, visibly progressive energy evolution. Each effect occupies under 40 percent of cell height. The sheet must be actually transparent between and around all effects, including gutters. Clean semitransparent antialiasing and halos only around luminous strokes, no opaque background.
Text: none. Avoid lettering, numbers, labels, grid lines, borders, checkerboard pattern, scenery, black or colored backdrop, broad smoke haze, circles filling the cell, a long beam, a literal fist, human body parts, logos and watermark.

promptSet.generate:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite atlas of six ground-impact warning magic rings for an original dark fantasy hand-painted side-scrolling action game.
Primary request: make ONE 1536 x 1024 RGBA image, genuinely transparent background, EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows, six independent complete TOP-DOWN CIRCULAR sigils, one per 512 x 512 cell, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. All six rings have almost identical overall diameter, about 380 px, centered precisely within each cell, with at least 55 px clear transparent gutter around every effect. Each is a thin annular warning ornament; center must be truly transparent and empty for readability, at least 55% of the ring diameter. Intended to be squashed into perspective on the ground by the game renderer. Do NOT pre-squash them.
Style/medium: polished original dark Gothic fantasy painted VFX with intricate but bold readable engraved material, restrained luminous edges, crafted detail, dramatic elemental energy, fine texture rather than flat vector geometry. The six themes must be visibly distinct.
Cell 1 upper-left FIRE: segmented ancient dark-gold rune ring with ember-lit magma cracks, a few curling orange-red flame tongues outward, warm golden embers, empty transparent center.
Cell 2 upper-middle NATURE: braided twisting living root ring with a few pointed leaves and buds, subtle ancient gold-green spirit etchings in the roots, restrained green-gold motes, empty transparent center.
Cell 3 upper-right FROST: jagged translucent silver-blue ice crystal rim, faceted frost shard tick marks, delicate engraved snowflake radial accents only on the annulus, cold blue radiance, empty transparent center.
Cell 4 lower-left LIGHTNING: sharp ivory-gold forked lightning threading a segmented dark metallic gauntlet-like rune ring, a few branching electrical spikes outward, energetic gold-white detail but no overexposed blobs, empty transparent center.
Cell 5 lower-middle SHADOW: blackened violet metal crescent rim with dark purple raven feather blades and curved knife-like score marks, subtle ultraviolet edge aura, empty transparent center.
Cell 6 lower-right STAR: midnight blue-violet astronomical orbit ring with weathered gold astrolabe marks and tiny sparse starlike nodes on the ring only, subtle astral etching, empty transparent center.
Constraints: all rings perfectly centered in their own cells, complete within cell, no overlap, consistent outer scale, circular top-down geometry, no labels, no words, no numbers, no watermark, no character or weapon, no floor, no stone disc filling the center, no rectangular backing, no black background, no white background, no checkerboard baked into image. Real alpha transparency outside AND inside each ring. Sparse particles, no giant vertical rays, no central burst, no scene, no title, no fake UI border. Each full ring must remain readable at small in-game scale.
promptSet.edit:
Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the attached six-ring sprite atlas.
Change ONLY transparency/background. Preserve the six existing elemental ring designs, their colors, shape, positions, dimensions, order, and hand-painted material textures exactly. Remove the unwanted hazy colored pale-grey background from the whole image AND from the empty centers of ALL SIX rings. The canvas must be genuinely transparent alpha=0 in blank spaces, including between rings, corners, and all six center holes. Keep the rings and their deliberate small outward flame/lightning/ice/feather details. Do not add anything; no texture or mist filling the center holes, no white/black/checkerboard background, no letters, no numbers. Keep 1536 x 1024, 3 columns x 2 rows, centered independent rings, no crop or rescale. This is a game-ready transparent cutout sprite atlas, not a poster.
